candidates.title: Account Persistence Reminder Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated notice screen before sign-in explaining that signing in saves pets permanently across devices.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in with different or guest accounts.

new_account_notice.headline: Keep Your Desktop Pets Safe
new_account_notice.body: Signing in ensures your pets and customization progress stay safely linked to your account.

components.text: Avoid losing your companion when reinstalling or changing devices.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_notice' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Guidance Stage
candidates.change: Inserts a pre-upload guideline screen that details lighting and angle tips for custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported failed or distorted custom pet generations during adoption.

new_photo_guide.headline: Tips for Great Custom Pets
new_photo_guide.body: For best pet generation, use well-lit photos facing forward with clear background contrast.

components.text: Clear photos produce cleaner, more vibrant desktop pets.

guard.reason: Valid addition of photo guidance screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeted pre-upload guidance screen addresses 3 support tickets at the adoption stage.

candidates.title: Background Pet Render Progress Hub
candidates.change: Adds a secondary status screen during rendering to inform users that setup can continue in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while rendering.

new_render_status.headline: Rendering Desktop Pet in Background
new_render_status.body: Your pet is being crafted. You can minimize this window while we finish setting up.

guard.reason: Valid addition of render status screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New status screen addresses extreme render wait times (mean 2336s) during home setup.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet First-Meeting Spotlight
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro with a spotlight layout emphasizing basic pet interactions like dragging, talking, and hiding.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or speak to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Pet to the Desktop
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to interact, hide, or open companion settings.

components.text: Try dragging your pet to your favorite corner of the desktop!

guard.reason: Valid spotlight redesign of home_intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Redesign at finish stage; redesign changes previously showed minimal impact (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Screen Troubleshooting Callout
candidates.change: Adds a subtle troubleshooting hint below sign-in options to help users whose screen stalls.
candidates.why: Support logged 2 emails where the sign-in screen failed to appear or stalled.

sign_in.hint: Screen not loading? Check your network connection or try restarting the desktop client.

guard.reason: Valid addition of troubleshooting hint to sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Simple hint addresses rare sign-in stalling reported in 2 support emails.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Memory Badge
candidates.change: Adds a celebratory companion parent badge to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your desktop companion is officially registered to your desktop!

guard.reason: Valid addition of celebratory parent badge to adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Badge incentive on adoption stage, which has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%).

candidates.title: Path Selection Quick Reassurance Copy
candidates.change: Updates headline and body copy on choose_path to clarify that path selection can be altered later.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating user hesitation when picking a path.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Starting Path
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to start. You can adopt additional pets or change modes anytime later.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on choose_path screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change to reassure users who hesitate (mean 514s) on path selection.

candidates.title: Waiting Stage Desktop Tray Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enables readiness notifications and clear time estimates on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting stage takes up to 2336s on average; clear notification hints reduce app abandonment.

waiting.hint: Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your pet lands on your screen!

guard.reason: Valid addition of readiness notification and time estimate to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Tray notifications directly target long waiting stage abandonment (2336s mean).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Selection Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with cheerful mascot elements.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 39.1%, making it the main bottleneck in the onboarding funnel.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Starter Companion
pick_friend.body: Pick the pet that best matches your workspace vibe.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage redesign; previous adoption redesign yielded only +0.4% lift.

candidates.change: Adds an onboarding completed banner component on the final home_intro screen.
candidates.why: Helps transition users smoothly into active desktop usage after finishing onboarding.

components.text: Look at your desktop to start interacting with your pet!

guard.reason: Valid addition of completion welcome banner to home_intro screen.
